title: DeltaML-Bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Real-World Research Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2608.19653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous agents for machine learning experimentation must navigate heterogeneous repositories, repair training pipelines, and evaluate candidate improvements under realistic compute constraints. Existing benchmarks only partially capture these conditions. We introduce DeltaML-Bench, a benchmark comprising 48 tasks sourced from research papers that require agents to improve published baselines within imperfect, open-source repositories. We evaluate GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4 with a standard Modular agent and a search-based ARG scaffolding. In the 4 x 6h allocation, ARG raises GPT-5's per-run success rate from 9.4% to 33.9%; in the 2 x 12h allocation, GPT-5 ARG reaches 49.0%. Modular configurations exhibit specification gaming rates as high as 47.9%, while no gaming is observed in the evaluated ARG configurations. translated_title: DeltaML-Bench：在真实研究仓库上评估机器学习代理
translated_abstract: 用于机器学习实验的自主代理必须能够导航异构仓库、修复训练流程，并在现实计算约束下评估候选改进方案。现有基准仅部分覆盖了这些条件。我们引入了DeltaML-Bench，一个包含48个源自研究论文的任务基准，要求代理在不完美的开源仓库中改进已发布的基线。我们评估了GPT-5和Claude Sonnet 4，使用标准模块化代理和基于搜索的ARG脚手架。在4×6小时分配下，ARG将GPT-5的单次运行成功率从9.4%提升至33.9%；在2×12小时分配下，GPT-5 ARG达到49.0%。模块化配置的规格游戏率高达47.9%，而评估的ARG配置未观察到游戏行为。这些结果表明，脚手架设计和完整性检查是部署代理时的重要考虑因素。
tldr: 本文提出DeltaML-Bench基准，通过48个真实研究仓库任务评估机器学习代理，发现ARG脚手架能显著提升成功率并消除规格游戏行为，强调了脚手架设计与完整性检查的关键性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DeltaML-Bench, a benchmark of 48 real-world repository tasks for evaluating ML agents, showing that ARG scaffolding significantly boosts success rates and eliminates specification gaming, highlighting the importance of scaffolding design and integrity checks.
